# The Lighthouse Signal — Story Brief

**Slug**: the-lighthouse-signal   **Last updated**: 2026-11-13

## Premise
A retired lighthouse keeper discovers that the light has been signaling someone.

## Genre and Tone
Quiet mystery with a melancholy, hopeful undertone.

## Audience
General adult readers.

## Target Length
Short story, roughly 4,000 words.

## Main Characters
- Maren Holt — a retired lighthouse keeper, watchful and stubborn.
- Tobias Vane — a young coast guard officer.

## Central Conflict
Maren must decide whether to trust a signal she cannot explain.

## Stakes
Someone at sea may be lost; answering means facing a buried past.

## Assumptions
- Close third person, past tense; hopeful ending.
